text:
eva: Quick idea — can we try a timeboxed design partner window (2 weeks) instead of a rolling invite? density of feedback will be higher and easier to compare across cohorts.
omar: +1. Also helps us align rollout checkpoints.
meera: Curious about recruitment funnel impact — do we risk fewer signups?
sam: We can mitigate with targeted early access perks (priority support, 1:1 onboarding) and clear expectations.
eva: draft success criteria I'm thinking: 
- 8 engaged partners per window (>=3 sessions + weekly async feedback)
- at least 2 integration pilots with API traffic > 5k tokens/day
- no regressions on latency/cost vs baseline
Would that work?
meera: Those are concrete. Can we add quality-of-feedback metric? e.g., number of reproducible bugs or proposal-actionable requests (>=5)
eva: good call — add: >=5 actionable items captured in GH per cohort.
omar: Ops question — do we need an SLA or dedicated capacity for DP traffic? Could be an ask from larger partners.
sam: For first two windows, use hosted but reserve a small dedicated pool for spike protection. Ops can autoscale but we need a fallback model routing policy.
meera: Recruiting screen (short):
```
1) primary use-case (chat/generation/embeddings)
2) prod usage? (none/low/high)
3) team size & decision owner
4) privacy constraints (ok to share traces?)
5) willingness to run a short integration test
```
Keep it <5 fields.
nina-legal: Need to vet the "share traces" language — recommend "share redacted traces" + optional DPA addendum for sensitive customers.
eva: noted. can you draft wording?
nina-legal: will post suggested text by EOD.
meera: Feedback loop plan: weekly 1hr sync, async Notion pulse (preset template), and a final evaluation checklist. We should capture prompts + golden outputs for regression tests.
sam: I'll own the Notion template and session facilitation.
meera: who owns the eval harness? we should auto-run it after each deploy to detect regressions.
omar: research/infra can pick up the harness, but product needs to maintain prompt sets. suggest pairing meera + eng-runtime for first run.
eva: owners: sam (ops & facilitation), meera (prompt sets & feedback capture), omar (deploy/harness coordination), nina-legal (contracts).
sam: Invite email draft idea: short blurb, clear ask + timebox, perks, link to screener. I'll post a first draft tomorrow.
eva: timeline proposal: 1 week recruitment, 2 week active window, 1 week wrap + eval = 4 weeks total. Pilot start target: 3 weeks from now.
meera: success gating for public beta: >=80% of actionables triaged and either fixed or scheduled; no P1 regressions; measurable engagement thresholds hit.
eva: if we hit gating, proceed to wider private preview. If not, iterate another cohort.
sam: small operational note — add a "drop-in" for partners who can't commit full sync cadence, to keep variety and funnel.
meera: agreed. capture as optional path in screener.
deployer-bot: deploy status: no deploys scheduled against DP pool for next 7 days.
eva: thanks — last ask: let's set a single Slack channel for partners feedback (prod-dp-feedback) and give sam/meera admin.
sam: setting channel now, will share link and invite script. :thumbsup:
meera: I'll create the Notion template and share.
omar: pairing for eval harness Monday 10am?
meera: works for me.
eva: great — I'll update the roadmap card and spin up a GH repo for the cohort artifacts.
